AGENDA
  AUDIT COMMITTEE
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING – 633 E Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Welcome to the Glendale Audit Committee Meeting. If you have any agenda related questions or requests for assistance,
call the Finance Department at (818) 548-2085 during business hours. Audit Committee Meetings are archived and
available for viewing on the City’s website at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/agendas-minutes. Audit Reports are
available for viewing on the following link: https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/departments/innovation-performance-
and-audit/audit-reports.

PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE HEARING ROOM.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation,
and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At
least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All
documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
are public records, will be available for review in the City Clerk’s Office at 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA
91206.

Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who wish to utilize the service
as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City Clerk’s office at 818-548-2090, at least 24 hours
prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.

  July 22, 2019 at 8:00 AM

 1. ROLL CALL

 2. BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The agenda for the July 22, 2019 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on Thursday, July 18,
  2019 on the bulletin board outside City Hall.

 3. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision. The
  Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.

 4. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on April 22, 2019

 5. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Election of Audit Committee Chair
  b. Election of Audit Committee Secretary
  c. Annual Report to City Council

 6. REPORTS – INFORMATION
  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 6/30/2019 – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager
   b. FY 2018-19 Audit Work Plan Status Update and Proposed FY 2019-20 Audit Work
  Plan – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager
  c. FY 2019-20 City Budget Adoption Update – Adrine Isayan, Deputy Director of Finance
  d. Report from Vavrinek, Trine, Day & Co., LLP on the Audit of FY ended June 30, 2019
  – Shu-Jun Li, Deputy Director of Finance

7. COMMITTEE /STAFF COMMENTS

8. NEW BUSINESS

9. ADJOURNMENT
minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  July 22, 2019

1.  ROLL CALL: 8:07 a.m.

  Present:  Zareh Amirian, Ed Khashadourian, Thomas O’Shaughnessy,
  Alex Parajon and Vahik Satoorian (absent)

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:

  A.  Report of Recording Secretary re: Posting of Agenda

  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of July 22, 2019 was posted on Thursday,
  July 18, 2019 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  Note: Agenda Item 6D was taken out of order and presented first.

  D.  Report from Vavrinek, Trine, Day & Co., LLP on the Audit of FY ended June 30,
  2019 – Shu-Jun Li, Deputy Director of Finance

  Accounting Supervisor, Ms. Theresa Clark, introduced Mr. David Showalter, CPA Audit
  Partner from Vavrinek, Trine, Day & Co. LLP. (VTD), the City’s External Auditor.
  Mr. Showalter informed the Audit Committee that VTD has merged with another CPA
  firm, Eide Bailly, LLP with the merger taking effect July 22, 2019. This merger will give
  Eide Bailly an expansion into California with 11 additional offices. Mr. Showalter
  reassured the Audit Committee that the merge will not impact VTD’s work with the City
  of Glendale. Next, Mr. Showalter gave a presentation on the City’s fiscal year ended
  June 30, 2019 Audit and highlighted several important accounting pronouncements.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  A.  Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on Monday, April 22, 2019.

  Moved: Thom O’Shaughnessy  Second: Ed Khashadourian

  Vote as follows:
  Ayes:  Amirian, Khashadourian, O’Shaughnessy, Parajon
  Noes:
  Abstain:
  Absent:  Satoorian
 Audit Committee Minutes
July 22, 2019
Page 2 of 3

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  A.  Election of Audit Committee Chair

  There was a brief discussion to move this item to the next meeting in order to have the full
  Audit Committee in attendance. After the discussion, it was decided to hold the election of the
  Chair as originally scheduled. Audit Committee Member Thom O’Shaughnessy nominated Mr.
  Zareh Amirian to continue as Chair of the Audit Committee. No other nominations were
  made.

  Moved: Thom O’Shaughnessy  Second: Ed Khashadourian

  Vote as follows:
  Ayes:  Amirian, Khashadourian, O’Shaughnessy, Parajon
  Noes:
  Abstain:
  Absent:  Satoorian

  B.  Election of Audit Committee Secretary

  Chair Amirian nominated Ms. Mary Tchagaspanian to continue as the Secretary to the Audit
  Committee.

  Moved: Zareh Amirian  Second: Thom O’Shaughnessy

  Vote as follows:
  Ayes:  Amirian, Khashadourian, O’Shaughnessy, Parajon
  Noes:
  Abstain:
  Absent:  Satoorian

  C.  Annual Report to City Council

  Chair Amirian read the letter titled “Audit Committee Annual Report for FY 2018-19” into the
  record. This letter which serves the as annual report of activities from the Audit Committee to
  the City Council will be reviewed by the City Council at an upcoming meeting. Audit
  Committee Member O’Shaughnessy made a recommendation to revise this letter to include
  the names of all Audit Committee members prior to it being presented to the City Council.

  Moved: Thom O’Shaughnessy  Second: Alex Parajon

  Vote as follows:
  Ayes:  Amirian, Khashadourian, O’Shaughnessy, Parajon
  Noes:
  Abstain:
  Absent:  Satoorian
 Audit Committee Minutes
July 22, 2019
Page 3 of 3

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  A.  Internal Audit Activity Report as of June 30, 2019 – Jessie Zhang, Internal
  Audit Manager

  Internal Audit Manager, Jessie Zhang updated the Audit Committee on the Internal Audit
  activity for quarter ended June 30, 2019.

  Ms. Zhang provided an update on the three projects in progress and the 12 outstanding audit
  issues that entered one of the three discussion criteria set by the Audit Committee in
  Resolution #2. The outstanding issues that have not been implemented within two years of the
  report date are: FASTER Fleet Asset Management System Audit, Marketplace Parking
  Garage Agreements Audit, and Records Management Audit.

  Sr. Public Works Manager, Shea Eccleston was present and answered questions regarding
  the outstanding issues from the FASTER Fleet Asset Management System Audit. The Parking
  Manager, Tad Dombroski was present and answered questions regarding the outstanding
  issue from the Marketplace Parking Garage Agreements Audit. The Audit Committee did not
  have any questions related to the outstanding issues in the Records Management Audit.

  B.  FY 2018-19 Audit Work Plan Status Update and Proposed FY 2019-20 Audit
  Work Plan – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager

  Internal Audit Manager, Jessie Zhang gave a presentation on the status of the adopted FY
  2018-19 Audit Work Plan and the proposed FY 2019-20 Work Plan. A discussion took place
  by the Audit Committee Members and Ms. Zhang answered questions. The Audit Committee
  members requested that the actual number of hours spent on conducting audits be included in
  next year’s work plan review.

  C.  FY 2019-20 City Budget Adoption Update – Adrine Isayan, Deputy Director of
  Finance

  Sr. Budget Analyst, Mari Karamyan gave a presentation on the City’s FY 2019-20 adopted
  budget and answered questions from Audit Committee members.

  Note: Agenda Item 6D was taken out of order and presented earlier.

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  None

8.  NEW BUSINESS:
  None

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian  Second: Alex Parajon
  Adjournment at 10:15 a.m.
